us.title: Sunlit Craftsman Bungalow
us.description: A fully renovated 1920s craftsman with original hardwood floors, a wraparound porch, and a detached studio out back — a short walk to the Maple Grove farmers market.

us.title: Modern Hillside Retreat
us.description: Floor-to-ceiling windows frame the valley from every main room; a chef's kitchen and a lower-level bonus suite make this one flexible for a growing family.

us.title: Cozy Two-Story Colonial
us.description: Move-in ready with an updated kitchen, a fenced backyard, and top-rated schools two blocks over — a solid first home.

us.title: Waterfront Contemporary
us.description: Private dock access and unobstructed bay views from the primary suite; the open-plan main floor was rebuilt in 2021.

us.title: Estate Vineyard Property
us.description: Sits on 3.2 acres of producing vines with a separate guest cottage, a wine cellar, and a pool overlooking the valley.

us.title: Downtown Loft Condo
us.description: Exposed brick, 12-foot ceilings, and an in-unit washer/dryer in a converted 1908 warehouse two blocks from the transit station.

india.title: Sunlit 2BHK Apartment
india.description: A fully fitted 2BHK on the 6th floor of a gated society, close to the IT corridor, with covered parking and a children's play area on-site.

india.title: Premium 3BHK Residence
india.description: Corner unit with a private balcony on both bedrooms, modular kitchen, and clubhouse access in a well-maintained, RERA-registered project.

india.title: Compact 1BHK Flat
india.description: Ideal for a first-time buyer or rental investment — close to schools, a hospital, and the main bus route into the city.

india.title: Luxury 4BHK Penthouse
india.description: Duplex penthouse with a private terrace, imported fittings, and dedicated staff quarters in one of Pune's most established addresses.

india.title: Family 3BHK Bungalow
india.description: Independent bungalow with a small garden and terrace, on a quiet residential lane close to Swargate.

india.title: Modern 2BHK Society Flat
india.description: Five minutes from the IT park by shuttle, with a gym, a landscaped podium garden, and 24-hour security in the society.
